predecessor.commit_subject: Freeze H4 private verifier format and atomicity

sealed_format_contract.rule: The implementation must consume this exact committed contract and may not relax any byte, canonicality, cryptographic, privacy, state, reserve, authority or live-effect rule.

implementation_scope.path_rule: The implementation commit delta against the handoff commit must equal this five-path allowlist. No rename, deletion, generated output, control result or ambient evidence is admitted.

scope: the exact EPRH4PV1 length-delimited common frame and all 37 immutable domains
bounded RFC 8949 core deterministic CBOR for the closed H4 private-verifier schema subset
all 26 frozen schema identities, including the nontransmitted private-token descriptor and 25 conveyed, authorization or retained schemas
schema-specific exact field inventory, type, constant, range, packed-vector and local cross-field validation
SHA-256 commitments, HMAC-SHA-256 private tokens and storage authentication joins
raw Ed25519 seed, public-key and detached-signature wrappers using CryptoKit with explicit canonical point, small-order and S-less-than-L rejection
pure_format_and_crypto_contract.decoder_order: Prove aggregate, declared and derived bounds before allocation; decode only allowed types; reject nonminimal, indefinite, duplicate, reordered, unknown, missing and trailing data; validate the selected schema; re-encode and require exact bytes before any cryptographic operation.
pure_format_and_crypto_contract.secret_input_rule: Production functions accept exact byte inputs but do not generate, persist, log or export keys, blinds, nonces or challenges. Tests use only fixed fabricated bytes.
pure_format_and_crypto_contract.local_source_digest_boundary: For canonical JSON and deterministic CBOR only, the implementation may compute the exact frozen framed preimage digests from exact H4-C stream bytes. D3 semantic, indexed-scalar, state/witness/transition graph, predicate-identifier and predicate-evidence source-to-digest projectors remain unfrozen, forbidden and unimplemented; only EPR_H4_PRIVACY_TESTS may supply fabricated typed 32-byte digest inputs for them. No live or full-D3 assertion may be issued from those inputs.
pure_format_and_crypto_contract.app_compilation_boundary: Both pure sources are added to the application target as inert library code and to the hostless test target. This slice adds no application call site, entry point, UI, automatic work, authority transition or runtime invocation; source and binary-surface review must confirm that boundary.
pure_format_and_crypto_contract.no_live_claim: Use of reviewed platform primitives in a hostless fabricated test does not qualify a physical key store, entropy source, transport or constant-time device boundary.

scope: one in-memory provisioned lineage with one serializer and up to 16 injected outstanding one-use challenges

abstract interruption outcomes for pre-linearization, durable-child-before-pointer, pointer-advanced-before-response, expectation mismatch, torn or unauthenticated data, old pointer, index gap and multiple child
pure_abstract_verifier_contract.response_boundary: Unsupported or malformed outer bytes and invalid challenge state produce no authenticated result, consume no challenge and read no authority state. Authenticated embedded rejection consumes only that challenge, emits one minimized class and reads no authority state.
pure_abstract_verifier_contract.mutation_rule: An admitting, conflict or terminal result is constructible only after the intended immutable record and authenticated pointer are committed and freshly read back. Ambiguity stops service for recovery and cannot manufacture a sibling record.
pure_abstract_verifier_contract.abstraction_limit: The in-memory store models state-machine and transaction outcomes. It is not SQLite, a physical device, a filesystem, a rollback-resistant store or a live authority.
